resources.string: This app needs MatonOS. Install MatonOS, then reopen this app.
MatonOS is too old for this app. Update MatonOS and reopen this app.
This app needs the MatonOS bridge permission. Reinstall it through MatonOS or trust its developer build.
Developer build not trusted. Run: adb shell content call --uri content://org.matonos.systembridge.shell --method trust --arg %1$s --extra targets:s:%2$s
The MatonOS %1$s service is unavailable. Connect or enable that device, then reopen this app.
The MatonOS bridge could not be reached. Restart MatonOS and reopen this app.
Trust requests are disabled in Developer options. Enable the option on the Trusted developer apps screen, or use adb shell content call on the bridge trust provider.
